name: websocket-reconnect-p2
prompt: how should the browser client recover its realtime connection after the websocket drops without losing messages

chunks.content: styled the chat bubbles with tails and grouped consecutive messages from one sender
messages persist to the messages table with a server-assigned sequence id
added an emoji picker to the composer toolbar
retired an old experiment flag now that the feature is default-on
a periodic ping/pong heartbeat detects a silently dead connection quickly and triggers the reconnect logic instead of waiting for a TCP timeout
let users paste an image directly into the composer
track p99 message delivery latency on the realtime path
messages the user sends while offline are queued in a local outbound buffer and flushed once the socket is healthy again, so a drop does not drop their input
presence indicators show which teammates currently have the document open
if the tab is backgrounded we fall back to a push notification
decided that on a socket close the client reconnects automatically with exponential backoff and jitter so a flaky network does not hammer the server
the client remembers the id of the last message it received and on reconnect asks the server to replay everything after that cursor so nothing is missed during the gap
typing indicators broadcast a short-lived event while a user is composing a message
the realtime endpoint upgrades the HTTP request to a websocket after checking the auth cookie
